description: Defines data classes, sealed classes, enums, and data objects related to authentication states, tokens, results, and errors within an Android app's authentication module.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: Represents the authentication lifecycle states for the UI/ViewModels, including LoggedOut, Locked, and Unlocked states.

classes.name: Locked
classes.description: Indicates a session that is locked, including the session tokens and the reason for locking.

classes.name: Unlocked
classes.description: Indicates a usable session with session tokens.

classes.name: SessionTokens
classes.description: Encapsulates the access token, refresh token, and expiration timestamp; includes a method to check token expiration.

classes.name: AuthResult
classes.description: Contains the session tokens and an optional server message, returned from login or token refresh operations.

classes.name: AuthOpResult
classes.description: A sealed class representing the result of an authentication operation, success or failure.

classes.name: AuthError
classes.description: Sealed class for various authentication-related errors, including storage, network, unauthorized, locked, no session, and unknown errors.

methods.name: isAccessTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks if the access token has expired based on the current epoch milliseconds.
